alternatives.name: Haystack
alternatives.why_not_default: The retained entry explicitly records prospective, unexecuted commands. No scoped code retrieval, embedding compatibility or recovery execution establishes an advantage over the selected stack.

alternatives.name: Hugging Face Hub native CLI
alternatives.why_not_default: Native verification checked 15 pinned Nemotron files. This remains a useful provisioning dependency, but does not itself provide the scoped index, embedding server or recoverable vector store covered by the three winners.

alternatives.name: pgvector
alternatives.why_not_default: Only pinned source review is retained; extension activation and retrieval/recovery were not executed. PostgreSQL metadata joins could justify adoption, but that requirement and an advantage over the current Qdrant index are unestablished.

alternatives.name: code-memory
alternatives.why_not_default: SQLite deployment simplicity is unmeasured. Reviewed tests establish response shape rather than retrieval relevance; embedding compatibility and recovery remain unexecuted. Source review identifies possible stale results after new exclusions or removal of all indexable files, but these are not observed runtime failures.

alternatives.name: LanceDB
alternatives.why_not_default: Embedded storage could remove a service, but the retained commands are prospective. No executed code-retrieval, freshness, embedding or restore comparison establishes superiority.

limits: This verdict reviews retained public evidence; no native client, GPU service or recovery execution was repeated.
Private raw command streams and model outputs were not inspected; public receipts retain selected results and provenance hashes.
Context-mode rejected the packet path because of its configured project root; native read-only commands successfully read the packet and all adopted-candidate evidence references.
Upstream metadata is the packet's dated snapshot and was not independently refreshed.
open_gaps: No sealed representative conceptual-code benchmark establishes comparative recall, grounded answer accuracy, cross-project isolation, latency or resource superiority.
Four paired upstream retrieval examples establish embedding compatibility, not cross-model or domain quality.
SocratiCode full-service restart/recovery and native-client rebinding remain unestablished; Qdrant recovery does not qualify the entire retrieval stack.
Hosted recovery used synthetic state within one administrative domain; production recovery, atomic cross-application snapshots and lost-account/key recovery remain unqualified.
The vLLM 0.29.0 failure is host-specific. The packet's newer 0.30.0 release has no retained runtime acceptance here.
code-memory's deployment advantage and source-level freshness concerns require executed comparisons.
fixtures/rag-note.md is a small seed fixture, not a held-out conceptual-code evaluation set.

arms: SocratiCode 1.14.0 with Qdrant 1.19.1 and vLLM 0.25.0 using the retained pinned Nemotron model
code-memory at reviewed commit 5a8db166ca11a90c093ba4a9a54d266cde756f54 with an explicitly pinned, permitted embedding model
Lexical retrieval baseline on identical frozen project sources
overturn_protocol.metric: Compare independently grounded retrieval accuracy, complete returned context, cold/warm latency, memory and indexing cost. Require no stale or excluded results after edits, renames, deletions, new exclusions and empty-corpus transitions; verify scope isolation and restored state/query equality. Existing fixtures supply bounded smoke and recovery checks; representative sealed questions still need to be established.

overturn_when: Reconsider if an executed comparison using fixtures/rag-note.md for mutation/retrieval smoke checks and blueprints/convergence-practice/offhost-app-state/README.md for state/query recovery checks demonstrates a challenger preserves required quality and lifecycle behavior with a material deployment or resource advantage. Require additional frozen conceptual-code questions with independent source locations before claiming quality superiority; fixture replay alone cannot overturn the selection.
why_selected: Select SocratiCode, Qdrant and the qualified vLLM 0.25.0 runtime as the complementary retrieval stack. evidence/receipts/native-rag.json records native execution: both clients retrieved the same correct project source span, real embeddings returned 2,048 finite dimensions, and automatic add/update/delete propagated into the vector store. docs/native-memory-rag-lifecycle.md records subsequent source agreement on a real question. evidence/receipts/hf-memory-models-20260921.json records execution of the upstream embedding example and compatible route, with all four intended documents ranked first. catalogs/foundation/decisions.json records same-host Qdrant snapshot/query recovery; blueprints/convergence-practice/offhost-app-state/README.md separately records synthetic hosted restoration with complete state/query equality, distinguishing unchanged upstream tests from local integration checks. This is bounded native functionality with partial recovery coverage, not measured superiority over alternatives.
